senses.gloss:
चौल चौल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चूला = चूडा), re-
lating to a crest or top-knot &c.; (अम्), n. ton-
sure; [cf. Gr. σκόλλυς.]
—चौल-कर्मन्, अ, n.
the ceremony of tonsure, cutting off all the hair from
the head of a child three years old except one lock
on the crown; [cf. चूडा, &c.]

चौलुक्य चौलुक्य, अस्, m. (fr. चुलुक), a
patronymic of Kumāra-pāla.
चौलुक, अस्, ई, अम्, an adjective derived from the last.
